verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms @babylonjs/core is published under Apache-2.0, a permissive open-source license that allows modifying and redistributing the engine. The docs also describe Babylon.js as an "open game and rendering engine," and community reports of filing bug reports and seeing fixes in nightly builds point to an open development process. missing for 10: explicit evidence of a public source repository with the full engine source, documentation on building or forking the engine from source, and hands-on accounts of developers patching engine internals.
